description: Repositories, forks and external services of the PatientWords project, with the exact artifact the engine consumes from each and the file that holds its pin. The latest source head of a repository and the pin the engine has executed are separate fields in every entry: a synced fork is not a migrated runtime. Structure is in schemas/ecosystem/repositories.v1.schema.json; vocabularies, commit formats and pin agreement are enforced by scripts/ecosystem_status.py and tests/test_ecosystem_manifest.py. The prose map is docs/ecosystem.md.

owner_preparation_note.status: owner-reported, not re-derived, except where an entry's upstream_relation.basis says what was verified
owner_preparation_note.statement: Before the 2026-11-10 change set the owner synced the five method forks with their upstreams: patientwords-interp-engine received 55 upstream commits, patientwords-inspect_petri 13, patient-words-jpp_lens merged one upstream README-only change and keeps its local commits, and patientwords-ica-lens-paper and jacobian-lens-patientwords were already current. At the recorded heads no upstream commit is missing from any of the five.
owner_preparation_note.scope: A source sync only. No runtime test, package upgrade, constraints.txt change or lock change was part of it. docs/upgrade_checklist.md is the procedure for a runtime change.
